runtime_dependency_check.scope: Configured prototype views, requested optional interaction document, reading entrypoints and their reachable local HTML/CSS resources. Unconfigured historical HTML is preserved as source, not promoted to a current runtime view. No JavaScript execution or network fetch.

source_reference_policy: Historical source coordinates remain original text; they are not portable execution references.

publication.scope: Current 2.0.0 prototype, requirements and consolidated developer handoff, published through the existing single-version view exporter.
